# Dr Shyam N Gupta, MD

> Fertility & IVF Specialist and Gynaecological Endoscopic Surgeon. Centre Head at
> Indira IVF, J.P. Nagar, Bengaluru, and Zonal Business Director for Indira IVF South India.

## Facts
- Full name: Dr Shyam Nandan Gupta, MD
- Location: Indira IVF, Woody's Building, 3rd Floor, Plot No. 45/1-1, near Bangalore Central Mall, J.P. Nagar, Bengaluru 560078, Karnataka, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 98999 84791
- Email: centerhead.bangalore@indiraivf.in
- Website: https://www.drshyamguptaivf.com/
- Experience: 12 years in reproductive medicine
- Qualifications: MBBS (Tribhuvan University, Nepal); MD Obstetrics & Gynaecology (B. P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences); MRCOG Part 1 (RCOG, UK); FIAGE; FMAS; Diploma in Male Infertility (MeDEA/ANDROFERT, Brazil); GMHE (IIM Bangalore)
- Roles: Centre Head, Indira IVF J.P. Nagar; Zonal Business Director South; Faculty, FNB Reproductive Medicine (National Board of Examinations); Committee member, ASPIRE Special Interest Group on Artificial Intelligence
- Procedure volumes: 12,000+ ovum pickups; 9,000+ embryo transfers; 8,000+ hysteroscopic procedures; 1,000+ laparoscopic surgeries; 500+ surgical sperm retrievals
- Research: 16 peer-reviewed publications, cited 1,300+ times; presented at ASRM, ESHRE and ASPIRE
- Languages: English, Hindi, Nepali, Bhojpuri; conversational Kannada and Bengali

## Clinical focus
- In vitro fertilisation (IVF)
- Intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI)
- Intrauterine insemination (IUI)
- Recurrent implantation failure treatment
- Recurrent miscarriage and reproductive immunology
- Lymphocyte immunisation therapy (LIT)
- Male infertility treatment
- Surgical sperm retrieval (TESA and PESA)
- PCOS treatment
- Endometriosis treatment
- Thin endometrium treatment
- Hysteroscopic surgery
- Laparoscopic surgery
- Fertility preservation
- High-risk pregnancy care

## Particular expertise
- Recurrent implantation failure: investigation of endometrium, immune factors, chronic endometritis (CD138), and male factor before repeating a transfer
- Recurrent miscarriage and reproductive immunology, including published live birth outcomes after low-dose lymphocyte immunisation therapy (LIT) with partner lymphocytes
- Male factor infertility including PESA and TESA surgical sperm retrieval for azoospermia, followed by ICSI
- Thin and refractory endometrium, including published pilot work on autologous blood cell derivatives in frozen embryo transfer cycles

## Selected publications
- Fertility Medicine in 2030: from IVF clinic to intelligent reproductive health systems
- When hope refused to give up
- Advanced fertility care in Bengaluru: services and approach
